title: Trade input encryption for a protected entangled resource at the same coarse-memory interface
statement: For the same complete qubit/bath CPTP call K_lambda=sum_s P_s tensor B_s_lambda, define Phi_s(sigma)=sum_lambda B_s_lambda*sigma*B_s_lambda^dagger. Corrected private Pauli transmission and trusted entanglement-first completed teleportation both give sum_s,lambda(P_s tensor B_s_lambda tensor I_E)rho_DME(P_s tensor B_s_lambda tensor I_E)^dagger. Destructive TEST at axis j has failure bath map sum_{s anticommutes j}Phi_s and pass map sum_{s commutes j}Phi_s in both interfaces. This is equality of full coarse CP maps, not just failure probabilities.

requires: The same identified full CPTP physical call and all future-accessible quantum/classical memory, with a logical qubit and common input/output identification.
Direct interface: actual trusted fresh private framing. Deferred interface: independent protected Bell pair, post-call isolated late choice and trusted complete Bell measurement/correction.

TEST is destructive; retire tested carriers, keys, preparation signs and fine local/Bell outcomes from all future-used state/control. Only the allowed coarse axis/parity records and completed outputs are reused.

body: This substitutes a protected entangled resource for input encryption and its secret controls; trusted terminal teleportation and output correction remain required. Prepare the Bell pair independently of message and bath, pass one half through the same full call, then privately choose TEST or USE only after that call is complete and the candidate is isolated. Expand the resource in orthogonal Bell sectors beta_s weighted by B_s_lambda. Bell contraction with each corrected teleportation outcome multiplies a sector by its Pauli character; averaging the four retired outcomes removes cross terms and produces the same twirled effective channel as direct private framing. Destructive parity measurement followed by discarding both resource halves similarly retains exactly the sectors with the chosen stabilizer sign. Averaging axes gives failure map(2/3)*sum_{s!=I}Phi_s and pass Phi_I+(1/3)*sum_{s!=I}Phi_s, hence F_fail=(2/3)W, W=sum_{s!=I,lambda}B_s_lambda^dagger*B_s_lambda in[0,I]. Equality holds on every memory operator and untouched reference, including initially correlated DME. It composes through permitted adaptive histories using coarse records/completed outputs, not through histories retaining or conditioning on retired keys, preparation signs, local fine outcomes or Bell outcomes. This is the Pauli-twirled service of the specified procedure, not exact unmodified simulation of an arbitrary channel from its Choi state. Different actual durations/couplings/terminal errors must be charged rather than hidden by logical naming.
